title.zh: Coinbase 与花旗扩大合作，为企业提供法币与稳定币支付通道
title.en: Coinbase and Citi Expand Partnership for Fiat-to-Stablecoin Business Payments

current_state.zh: 花旗与Coinbase的合作伙伴关系已从探索性计划推进到两个明确的客户支付路径：机构客户可通过Spring by Citi接收稳定币支付，Coinbase Virtual Accounts客户可将法币收入自动转换为稳定币，但客户数量、交易量和定价等细节尚未披露。
current_state.en: The Citi-Coinbase partnership has advanced from an exploratory plan to two defined customer payment paths: institutional clients can accept stablecoin payments via Spring by Citi, and Coinbase Virtual Accounts customers can auto-convert fiat receipts into stablecoins, though customer counts, volumes, and pricing remain undisclosed.

updates.title_zh: 花旗与Coinbase扩大7×24小时法币通道，覆盖逾1.5亿用户
updates.title_en: Citi and Coinbase Expand 24/7 Fiat Access for 150M-Plus Users
updates.what_changed_zh: 花旗与Coinbase将全天候法币通道扩展至合计超过1.5亿用户群。
updates.what_changed_en: Citi and Coinbase extend 24/7 fiat access to a combined user base of more than 150 million.
updates.current_state_zh: 花旗与Coinbase扩大合作，为企业提供连接传统法币支付与稳定币的基础设施，并将全天候法币通道扩展至合计超过1.5亿的用户群。
updates.current_state_en: Citi and Coinbase are expanding their partnership to give businesses infrastructure connecting traditional fiat payments with stablecoins, extending round-the-clock fiat access to a combined user base of more than 150 million.
updates.detailed_summary_zh:
花旗与Coinbase正在扩大合作，为企业提供连接传统法币支付与稳定币的基础设施，并将全天候法币通道扩展至合计超过1.5亿的用户群。相关报道将这一企业级稳定币支付合作描述为一项计划中的合作。

拓宽银行与交易所之间的支付通道，使用户能够全天候进行法币出入金，把受监管的银行结算直接连接到加密货币交易场所。

报道将该举措定性为一项计划中的企业级稳定币支付合作，并以合计逾1.5亿的用户群为规模定位。
updates.detailed_summary_en:
Citi and Coinbase are expanding their partnership to give businesses infrastructure that connects traditional fiat payments with stablecoins, extending round-the-clock fiat access to a combined user base of more than 150 million. Reports describe the corporate stablecoin payments effort as a planned collaboration.

Broadening bank-to-exchange payment rails gives users round-the-clock on-ramp and off-ramp access, linking regulated banking settlement directly to crypto trading venues.

Reports characterize the initiative as a planned corporate stablecoin payments collaboration, framed around a combined user base of more than 150 million.
updates.background_zh: 法币“入金通道”和“出金通道”是法币与加密资产相互兑换的服务，充当传统金融体系与数字资产市场之间的桥梁。面向企业的稳定币支付基础设施也在扩张，一份检索资料称企业对企业（B2B）稳定币支付同比增长733%，达到2260亿美元。
updates.background_en: Fiat on-ramps and off-ramps are the services that convert government-issued currency into crypto and back, acting as the bridge between the traditional financial system and digital-asset markets. Stablecoin payment infrastructure for businesses is also expanding, with one search reference citing B2B stablecoin payments rising 733% year over year to $226 billion.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该合作聚焦于法币出入金环节，银行结算的速度与可用性决定了资金在银行账户与加密交易场所之间的流转效率。因此，7×24小时通道的扩展可能影响Coinbase交易资产的流动性状况，以及用于企业支付的稳定币资金流。
updates.market_impact_en: The tie-up targets the fiat on/off-ramp layer, where banking settlement speed and availability determine how quickly capital can move between bank accounts and crypto venues. Expanded 24/7 rails could therefore affect liquidity conditions for Coinbase-traded assets and the stablecoin flows used in corporate payments.

updates.title_zh: Coinbase为花旗的新稳定币通道提供支持，企业银行业务面临重大变革
updates.title_en: Coinbase powers Citi’s new stablecoin rails, and corporate banking faces a major shift
updates.what_changed_zh: 花旗机构客户现可通过Spring by Citi使用Coinbase支付基础设施接收稳定币支付；Coinbase Virtual Accounts可通过花旗的Virtual Account Wallet自动将收到的法币转换为稳定币。
updates.what_changed_en: Citi institutional clients can now accept stablecoin payments through Spring by Citi using Coinbase payments infrastructure, and Coinbase Virtual Accounts can automatically convert incoming fiat into stablecoins via Citi's Virtual Account Wallet.
updates.current_state_zh: 花旗与Coinbase的合作伙伴关系已从探索性计划推进到两个明确的客户支付路径：机构客户可通过Spring by Citi接收稳定币支付，Coinbase Virtual Accounts客户可将法币收入自动转换为稳定币，但客户数量、交易量和定价等细节尚未披露。
updates.current_state_en: The Citi-Coinbase partnership has advanced from an exploratory plan to two defined customer payment paths: institutional clients can accept stablecoin payments via Spring by Citi, and Coinbase Virtual Accounts customers can auto-convert fiat receipts into stablecoins, though customer counts, volumes, and pricing remain undisclosed.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Coinbase said on Sept. 28 that Citi institutional clients can accept stablecoin payments through Spring by Citi using Coinbase payments infrastructure, while Coinbase Virtual Accounts can auto-convert incoming fiat into stablecoins through Citi's Virtual Account Wallet.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Coinbase said on Sept. 28 that Citi institutional clients can accept stablecoin payments through Spring by Citi using Coinbase payments infrastructure, while Coinbase Virtual Accounts can auto-convert incoming fiat into stablecoins through Citi's Virtual Account Wallet.
updates.background_zh: 此次具名服务源自 2025 年 10 月的公告：花旗当时表示与 Coinbase 计划共同开发机构数字资产支付能力，初期聚焦于 Coinbase 出入金通道的法币收付款以及支付编排。花旗当时称后续会推出具体项目，而 9 月 28 日的说明将其中两项明确为面向客户的支付路径。Spring by Citi 是花旗的商户支付平台。
updates.background_en: The named services follow an October 2025 announcement in which Citi said it and Coinbase intended to develop institutional digital asset payment capabilities, initially focused on fiat pay-ins and pay-outs for Coinbase's on- and off-ramps and on payment orchestration. Citi said specific initiatives would follow, and the Sept. 28 description sets out two of them as customer-facing payment paths. Spring by Citi is Citi's merchant payments platform.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该安排将银行结算与稳定币受理及法币兑稳定币转换连接起来，这一通道涉及稳定币发行方、支付与托管服务商，以及提供基础设施的交易所。由于未披露客户、交易量或支持的稳定币，仅凭该公告无法判断其短期流动性或供应影响规模。
updates.market_impact_en: The arrangement links bank settlement with stablecoin acceptance and fiat-to-stablecoin conversion, a channel that touches stablecoin issuers, payment and custody providers, and exchanges supplying the infrastructure. Because no customers, volumes or supported stablecoins were disclosed, the near-term liquidity or supply effect cannot be sized from the announcement alone.
